Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 41

“Here the resolute understanding is single, Kurunandana. The thoughts of the irresolute are many-branched and endless.”

A precise psychological observation. Indecision does not produce one alternative but an unlimited spread of them, and the spread itself is the affliction — Arjuna's whole morning has been exactly this.
